AI Advisor

The front door to AI at School Tech for any staff member.
Try this: "I spend about an hour a week pulling the same report by hand — could AI help with that, and is there already a tool set up for it?"

What it is

A shared Claude.ai Project that helps any staff member explore where AI could help their workflows, understand what's already live in the AI system, and frame an idea clearly to bring to Adam. It routes all implementation back to the IT team.

What it knows

The STA org context (who we are, products, customers, team), the current AI system (what's live, in dev, and planned), and where AI typically adds value.

How to access

Sign in at claude.ai with your @k12sta.com email and open AI Advisor in your Projects list.
